_comment: 2026/27 Premier League fixture list — ALL 380 matches as published by the Premier League on 19 June 2026 (premierleague.com news article 4675097). No fixtures invented: kickoff times are UK time as published, defaults 15:00 (weekend/Bank Holiday) and 20:00 (midweek) where the league did not publish a specific time. All fixtures subject to change by the Premier League.
source: Official Premier League fixture release, 19 June 2026
kickoffNote: Kick-off times are UK time as published by the Premier League. Weekend and Bank Holiday matches default to 15:00 UK and midweek matches to 20:00 UK unless the league published a specific time. Lagos (WAT) is the same as UK summer time and one hour ahead of UK winter time.
subjectToChange: All fixtures are subject to change — the Premier League explains the reasons fixtures move here: https://www.premierleague.com/news/4324634
